name: Sugar
notes: High glycaemic index; linked to obesity and diabetes.

name: Palm Oil
notes: High in saturated fats; environmental concerns.

name: Wheat Flour
notes: Contains gluten; refined flour has low nutritional value.

name: Skimmed Milk Powder
notes: Good source of protein and calcium.

name: Soy Lecithin
notes: Generally recognised as safe; some sensitivity concerns.

name: Sodium Benzoate
notes: May form benzene (carcinogen) when combined with vitamin C.

name: Vanillin
notes: Synthetic flavour; safe in small quantities.

name: Salt
notes: Essential mineral; harmful in excess — raises blood pressure.

name: Tbhq
notes: Synthetic antioxidant linked to adverse effects at high doses.
